errors.explanation: Tense/aspect error: “作られた” should be “作られている”. In Japanese, た marks completion or the past and ている an ongoing action or resulting state; a verb before 前に takes the non-past and a verb before 後で takes the past, whatever the tense of the main clause.
errors.model_note: “作られた” makes the robots’ production a completed past event; “作られている” describes how they are made in the future context.
